mostWorthwhile.text: Building the mucus-covered wall was most worthwhile because it showed both water recovery and how bacterial products can help lining cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the lining to its supporting tissue was clear but felt mostly like a setup step.

surprise.text: I didn't expect bacteria breaking down fibre to produce gas as well as small fatty acids.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable, although I followed the compatible menu rather than discovering them myself.

continue.text: I would continue to see more connections between body systems and what microbes contribute, though the wall assembly itself was fairly straightforward.
